About Organization

The Allahabad High Court is the high court of the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. It has its seat in Prayagraj (formerly known as Allahabad).

The Allahabad High Court was established in 1866.

About the Programme

The Allahabad High Court Research Associates programme is a recruitment programme for law graduates.

The programme aims to provide an opportunity for law graduates to work with the Indian Judiciary and gain experience in the field of law.
